# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/SiegeSailor/Website/security/advisories/new) or by email to siegesailor@gmail.com. Do not open a public issue for security reports.

You can expect an acknowledgement within a week. Only the latest deployment of [jinyu-zhang.com](https://jinyu-zhang.com/) is supported.
